steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Agh... I died! I was this close to beating that boss!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's alright. This hologram simulation is just a mini-game anyway.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Players just want their rewards, so... you'll still get something even if you don't beat the boss.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Why didn't you tell me earlier?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold up! If that's the case, why can't I just get all the rewards now?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, Hecate, wait! You haven't answered my question!
